hunks.baseline: Was this not a completely outrageous boy? He would watch and learn—someone else’s martial arts, of all things. His martial arts.
hunks.sol: What an absurd boy. He meant to learn just by watching—and the martial arts he intended to watch were *Mungyeong’s*.

hunks.baseline: But he did not dislike it.
hunks.sol: Yet Mungyeong didn’t mind.

hunks.baseline: “Oh. You smiled.”
hunks.sol: “Oh! You smiled.”

hunks.baseline: “……I did no such thing.”
hunks.sol: “……I did not.”

hunks.baseline: “You did. You smiled.”
hunks.sol: “You did. I saw you.”

hunks.baseline: “How dare you, you young brat.”
hunks.sol: “You impudent little brat.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh. You’re getting angry.”
hunks.sol: “Oh. Now you’re angry.”

hunks.baseline: “Would you like some dumplings?”
hunks.sol: “Would you like a dumpling?”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong hesitated over whether to draw his short sword.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong hesitated, wondering whether to draw his short sword. Instead, he took the dumpling Cheongpung offered and bit into it.

hunks.baseline: In the end, he accepted the dumpling Cheongpung held out and chewed.

hunks.baseline: The taste was not bad.
hunks.sol: It tasted rather good.
